2	
3	**Branch**: none — no branch hook is installed; the work stays on `main` (feature directory `specs/003-fix-rooms-pagination`) | **Date**: 2026-11-10 | **Spec**: [spec.md](./spec.md)

9	## Summary
10	
11	The rooms list returns the wrong rooms for any page after the first when the page size is not 10.
12	
13	1. **Cause** — `RoomRepository.findPage` in `apps/room` skips `(page − 1) × DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE` rooms
14	   instead of `(page − 1) × limit`. The full analysis, including why no existing test fails, is in
15	   [research.md](./research.md) and was written before any code change (FR-007).
16	2. **Regression test** — new cases in `room.repository.spec.ts`, written first and seen to fail:
17	   the reported case (page 2 at 5 per page), further offsets, and a walk over all pages at page
18	   sizes 1, 5, 10, 12 and 100.
19	3. **Fix** — one expression in `room.repository.ts`, plus the removal of the import it no longer
20	   needs.
21	
22	Two files change, both in `apps/room`. No route, DTO, constant, error code, table, migration or
23	dependency is added or changed, and the web app is not edited.
24	
25	## Technical Context
26	
27	**Language/Version**: TypeScript 5.9 on Node 22 or newer
28	
29	**Primary Dependencies**: NestJS 11 (NATS microservice `room`), TypeORM 0.3 — already installed; no dependency is added
30	
31	**Storage**: PostgreSQL 15, table `rooms` as it is, read only; no schema change and no migration
32	
33	**Testing**: Jest 29 through Nx (`pnpm run test`, `pnpm exec nx test room`); `@nestjs/testing` with the TypeORM repository mocked, as the existing room specs do; the end-to-end path is proven against the running stack (quickstart)
34	
35	**Target Platform**: Node services and a browser frontend, run locally through `pnpm run stack:up` (Docker for Postgres, Redis and NATS)
36	
37	**Project Type**: Web application in an Nx monorepo — HTTP gateway, NATS services, queue worker, Next.js frontend
38	
39	**Performance Goals**: none; the query keeps its shape (one ordered, limited read with a count)
40	
41	**Constraints**: fix limited to the defect (FR-009); response shape, ordering, defaults and input rejection unchanged (FR-005, FR-006); analysis committed before the code change (SC-003); failing test before the fix; no new dependency; every code file under 200 lines; `.env` files are never read
42	
43	**Scale/Scope**: a demo system with 12 seeded rooms; 1 edited source file and 1 edited spec in `apps/room`; everything else untouched

54	|---|---|---|
55	| I. Contract as Source of Truth | Nothing is added to or changed in `@roombook/contract`. The fix uses the `limit` field of the existing `PageQueryDto`; the repository stops using `DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE`, which stays the DTO's default. No error path changes. | PASS |
56	| II. Layered Architecture | No controller or service changes. The offset is data access and stays in the repository. No transaction, module registration, configuration value or deployable changes. | PASS |
57	| III. Strict TypeScript | No `interface`, no `any`, no inline object parameter type; `findPage` keeps its explicit return type; named imports only. | PASS |
58	| IV. Small, Self-Describing Files | No new file. `room.repository.ts` stays at 30 lines; `room.repository.spec.ts` grows from 62 lines to well under 200. No comment is added. | PASS |

| Room service | `apps/room/src/room/room.service.ts` | passes them to the repository |

With the 12 seeded rooms in name order:

| Reported observation | Request | Skipped today | Taken | Result today | Explained |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Page 1 is right at every page size | page 1, any limit | (1 − 1) × 10 = 0 | limit | the first `limit` rooms | the factor is multiplied by 0 |

  access and the service only delegates; a shared paging helper for both repositories — rejected, two

  MUST NOT contain logic.

  its body.

- Database transactions MUST live in repositories only, never in services.

  over NATS.

  environment variables read through the config module.

  service, exposed by the gateway as `GET /api/health/<service>`.

# Tasks: No Overlapping Bookings for the Same Room

**Input**: Design documents from `/specs/002-prevent-booking-overlap/`

**Organization**: Tasks are grouped by user story so each story can be implemented and tested on its own.

## Format: `[ID] [P?] [Story] Description`

- **[P]**: Can run in parallel (different files, no dependency on an incomplete task)
- **[Story]**: Which user story the task belongs to (US1–US4)
- Every task names the exact file it creates, edits or runs

## Path Conventions

Nx monorepo, paths from the repository root: `libs/contract/src/lib/…`, `apps/booking/src/booking/…`, `apps/web/src/views/bookings/…`. A spec sits next to its source file as `*.spec.ts` / `*.spec.tsx`.

## Rules that apply to every task

- The only change to `libs/contract` is T002 (FR-015). Nothing is changed in `apps/room`, `apps/gateway`, `apps/worker`, `libs/backend-common`, `apps/web/src/views/rooms`, `apps/web/src/pages`, `apps/web/src/services`, `package.json` or `specs/001-room-bookings` (FR-021, FR-022). No table, migration, route, message pattern or dependency is added.
- Errors are raised with `ExceptionHelper` from `@roombook/backend-common` and an `ErrorCodeEnum` value from `@roombook/contract`.
- No `interface`, no `any`, no inline object type as a parameter, explicit return type on every repository method and query function, named imports only, kebab-case file names, every file under 200 lines, no narrative comments.

1. **Spec files and the 200-line limit.** plan.md lists the existing specs as "edit", but four of them are within 25 lines of the limit.
